Scope and uncertainty

Abilene site only, not the entire Stargate initiative. OpenAI confirms OCI and GB200. Oracle documents 72 GPUs per NVL72 rack; a rack is not treated as one compute node. Exact site inventory, per-node configuration and scale-out fabric are not verified.
